newsitem.title: USA: Phonetel files to offer common stock, notes.
newsitem.headline: Phonetel files to offer common stock, notes.

text.p: PhoneTel Technologies Inc said it has filed registration statements with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for the public offerings of $25 million of common stock and $110 million of notes.
A portion of the proceeds of these offerings will be used to finance the merger with Cherokee Communications Inc, which Phonetel will acquire for $54 million.
The registration statements relating to these securities have been filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission but have not yet become effective.
PhoneTel, an independent U.S. pay telephone operator, operates about 25,000 public pay telephones, principally in Florida, Missouri, Ohio, South Carolina, Tennessee and Texas.
